entry.content: filter_listings: description, inputSchema +Prices are in each market's own currency: PLN in Poland, CZK in Czechia, EUR in the euro countries. When the user states a budget in a different currency ("up to 1,000 euros a month" in Warsaw), pass the amount as they said it plus `price_currency` (ISO code, e.g. "EUR"): Cubi converts it at the day's ECB reference rate and the reply says what it applied. entry.content: search_jobs: description +Unless the user asks for a different format, present results as the provided markdown table (Title / Company, Location, Salary, Tech stack, Certifications requested), followed by the searchUrl link. Certification tags mean the job posting itself requests that certification (as a requirement or a preference). When a job matches a certification filter, say plainly that the posting requests that certification - do not add caveats or hedge. Only distinguish required vs. preferred if the user explicitly asks, using get_job to read the description.
